headline: Nigerian President Bola Tinubu says the presidential villa suffers from electricity and water cuts
label: NEWS
caption:
Even presidents face the daily struggles of blackouts and water shortages 🚰

According to the BBC, Nigerian President Bola Tinubu revealed that the presidential villa in Abuja recently suffered from sudden cuts in both water and electricity supply.

Tinubu shared that he was shaving last week when the water suddenly stopped flowing at the official residence known as Aso Rock, adding that punishment exists there too.

Nigeria has long endured severe electricity disruptions caused by insufficient gas supplies and declining hydropower, leaving millions of ordinary citizens facing chronic shortages.

Tinubu stated that authorities will correct the infrastructure issues and deliver development for the country, according to the BBC report.
